acceptance_basis: Release authorization after review of the three incomplete publication gates. This decision does not assert that unfinished technical checks passed.
source_scope: Tracked sources of all four lockstep packages; only changelogs, lockstep version metadata, and the publication gate and its tests are normalized or excluded.
retained_requirements: All 113 visual pages and the original pixel and layout thresholds
Every required interaction page and byte-exact frame
Recorded macOS preedit, commit, cancel, focus and caret observations
At least five editor host contracts
Successful documentation browser checks at three or more viewports
